description: Ex-Bundeswehr H-34G, the type Heeresflieger units flew before the UH-1D. Traditions collection of Hubschraubergeschwader 64 inside the Kurt-Georg-Kiesinger-Kaserne at Laupheim; the site is a military security area and civilian visitors must register in advance. Aircraft stand in the open area beside the collection building. Individual serials are not published except for the CH-53G, so they need reading on site.
